main_text.p: Aliûs autem, πληθυντικῶς בלשון רבים, vix apud Græcos Scriptores. Vox in Chri-stianâ Ecclesiâ post Valentini portenta nimiũm nota. Nihilo opportunius alte-rum illud, quod Camero profert exem-plum, nunquam sc. dicturum fuisse Pau-lum, μήποτε [illegible, ~12 letters] μὲν, Hebr.ii.1. Egre-gie! An quia nova Scriptoribus sacris me-taphora est ? Atqui eadem illa perquàm familiaris. ii.Sam.xiv.14, futuri velut a-quæ diffluentes. Psalm.lviii.8, liquef-fiant sicut aqua. Christus in Evangelio, de utribus perruptis & vino effuso, sive diffluente, Matt.ix.17. An quia vox magis ad Græcam accedit elegantiam ? Sed & ipsi LXX. (notante etiã Camerone) eodem modo vertunt, Proverb.iii.21, ἐς μὴ πα-ῥῥησίᾳ[?]. An quia ab istiusmodi metaphoris abhorret Pauli genius? Imò in iis ferè to-tus est ; hinc Paulo doctrinæ vento agita-ri, currere, certare, stare, cadere, planta-re, rigare, parturire &c. Hinc similia illa à vasis testaceis, figulo, domo, fundamen-to, theatro, fermento, lacte, sigillo, arrhâ, aliisque pænè sine numero.

page.notes: Greek phrase in the Hebrews reference (line 6) is too blurred to read letter by letter and is marked illegible. The Greek in the Proverbs reference (line 17–18) is uncertain and marked [?]. The Hebrew "בלשון רבים" is copied as printed. "nimiũm" is a tilde-marked u as printed, uncertain. The Roman numeral "xiv" and "lviii" are read from the scan and marked as printed. No marginal notes are present on this page.
